prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1240
Claimant:
Tonya Trujillo
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
2023-06-03
Claim opened after the claimant reported a low-speed head-on collision at a residential intersection. The claimant is
not represented by an attorney and gave a verbal account by phone.
2023-07-25
Reviewed the police report and the photos taken at the scene. The report confirms the claimant was seated in the
vehicle at the time of the collision, and the other driver's statement matches the claimant's description of how the
impact occurred.
2023-08-07
Spoke with two independent witnesses who saw the collision. Both describe the same sequence of events, and
neither reported any unusual behavior by either driver.
2023-09-15
Inspected the vehicle. The front-end damage is consistent with the impact decsribed and with the photos taken at the
scene. No prior damage to the vehicle is recorded in the file.
2023-09-27
The claimant reported shoulder pain and was evaluated at an urgent care facility. The reported injury is plausible for a
collision of this type, and no prior injury to the same area is known from the claimant's history or medical records
obtained so far.
2023-09-28
Treatment followed a typical course, with physical therapy and medication. The claimant's notes show steady
improvement, and the frequency of visits has tapered as the claimant's ragne of motion has returned.
2023-10-28
A neighbor contacted the office and said the vehicle looked damaged a few weeks before the reported collision. The
neighbor's recollection is unverified and has not been matched to any record, so I am following up with the claimant
and the repair shop for prior service history.
2023-11-20
The claimant has given the same account of the collision in every conversation so far. The driver is named on the
policy, and the claim remains open pending receipt of the remaining repair and treatment records.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
{"findings": [{"feature": "", "rating": "", "confidence": "", "quote": "", "reason": ""}]}
